'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello. I have an errand for you. One of our people decided he could use my distribution lines on his own. It looks like our "entrepreneur" is marketing to cultists with souvenir figurines. Find them and bring them back, and I'll examine their insides.}}

==Objectives==
* Find a [[Ded Moroz figurine]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the item to [[Fence]]
* Find a [[Politician Mutkevich figurine]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the item to [[Fence]]
* Find a [[Killa figurine]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]

==Rewards==
* +22,800 [[EXP]]
* [[Fence]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 1,800 Euros
** 1,890 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 2,070 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 3× [[Virtex programmable processor]]
{{quote|Thanks. My suspicions have been confirmed. I hope you understand this job is not to be talked about.}}
